BiblicalUsage: Uel is a son of Bani, one of those who had taken strange wives in the days of Ezra. In Ezra 10:34, Maadai, Amram, and Uel.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Uel belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
